attributeDefinitions.description: Semantic definition of connector telemetry log attributes.

defenseclaw.codex.notify.type.description: Sanitized Codex notify payload type, e.g. agent-turn-complete, malformed, or empty for parsed payloads without a type.

defenseclaw.connector.enforced.description: True when the hook decision was an enforced block. Mirrors audit_events.enforced.

defenseclaw.connector.rule_pack_dir.description: Effective rule-pack directory the verdict used. Mirrors audit_events.rule_pack_dir.

defenseclaw.connector.source.description: Connector that produced the event. `unknown` is used when an older client omits the source header.

defenseclaw.connector.step_idx.description: 1-indexed per-turn counter within a session. Mirrors audit_events.step_idx and the hook audit envelope step_idx.

description: OTEL LogRecord emitted for connector hook invocations, connector-native OTLP ingest batches, and Codex notify bridge events. Metrics for the same surfaces are defined in metrics.schema.json.
title: DefenseClaw Connector Telemetry Event
